name: Fulfilling a customer's order
case: One order: a row of ordering.orders (Ordering.Infrastructure/EntityConfigurations/OrderEntityTypeConfiguration.cs:7; Ordering.Infrastructure/Migrations/OrderingContextModelSnapshot.cs:155-189)
starts_at: The order's record is written in Submitted: Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:40-51 (new Order, Add, SaveEntitiesAsync), status set at Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:57, committed by Ordering.API/Application/Behaviors/TransactionBehavior.cs:47
ends_at: The customer has the goods: the order is delivered. The code's last recorded state is Shipped (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:130-140; Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/OrderStatus.cs:12); the stretch to delivery is added from the reference model (ST4). Or definitively not: the order is Cancelled, for lack of stock (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:155-168), a failed payment or the customer's request (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:142-153)
expectation_of: The customer who placed the order (the buyer, ordering.buyers; Ordering.API/Application/Queries/OrderQueries.cs:37-49 lists a buyer's orders)
promise: none stated; proposed: none assumed by the code end to end. The code assumes about 2 minutes from placing to Paid (ST2) and nothing for shipping or delivery
case_identifier: ordering.orders "Id", from the HiLo sequence orderseq (Ordering.Infrastructure/EntityConfigurations/OrderEntityTypeConfiguration.cs:11-12), shown to the customer as OrderNumber (Ordering.API/Application/Queries/OrderQueries.cs:43). Lost at creation: POST /api/orders answers 200 with no body (Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:166), so neither front end learns the new id; the client's x-requestid is kept in ordering.requests (Ordering.API/Apis/OrdersApi.cs:119, 146; Ordering.API/Application/Commands/IdentifiedCommandHandler.cs:48; Ordering.Infrastructure/Idempotency/RequestManager.cs:21-37; Ordering.Infrastructure/Migrations/OrderingContextModelSnapshot.cs:249) with no link to the order. Carried as OrderId in every order integration event and in the outbox "Content" JSON (IntegrationEventLogEF/IntegrationEventLogEntry.cs:16). Lost at Basket API: OrderStartedIntegrationEvent carries only the user id (Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:32)
